name: Cult of the Possessed

specialRules.name: Mutations
specialRules.text: Mutants and Possessed may buy mutations only when recruited. The first mutation costs the price indicated; second and subsequent mutations for the same model cost double. Available: Daemon soul (20 gc): Has a 7+ save against the effects of spells or prayers. Great claw (50 gc): One arm ends in a great claw: may carry no weapon in that arm, but gains an extra attack in hand-to-hand combat with +1 Strength. Cloven hoofs (40 gc): +1 Movement. Tentacle (35 gc): May grapple an opponent in close combat to reduce his attacks by -1, to a minimum of 1. The mutant chooses which attack is lost. Blackblood (30 gc): If the model loses a wound in close combat, anyone in base contact suffers a Strength 3 hit (no critical hits). Spines (35 gc): Any model in base contact suffers an automatic Strength 1 hit at the start of each close combat phase. Never causes critical hits. Scorpion tail (40 gc): An extra Strength 5 attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase. If the model hit is immune to poison, the Strength is reduced to 2. Extra arm (40 gc): May use any single-handed weapon in the extra arm, giving +1 attack in hand-to-hand combat; alternatively may carry a shield or buckler in it. A Possessed that does this gains an extra attack but still cannot carry a weapon. Hideous (40 gc): The mutant causes fear.

fighters.name: Magister

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any models in the warband within 6" of the Magister may use his Leadership instead of their own.

fighters.notes: Each warband must have exactly one Magister.

fighters.name: Possessed

specialRules.name: Mutations
specialRules.text: May start with one or more mutations; cost in addition to hire cost.

fighters.notes: 90 gc plus the cost of mutations.

fighters.name: Mutant

specialRules.name: Mutations
specialRules.text: Must start with one or more mutations; cost in addition to hire cost.

fighters.notes: 25 gc plus the cost of mutations.

specialRules.name: Crazed
specialRules.text: Automatically passes any Leadership test it is required to take.

fighters.name: Brethren
fighters.notes: Bought in groups of 1-5. Any number allowed.

fighters.name: Beastman Gor
fighters.notes: Bought in groups of 1-5. Listed as Beastmen in the PDF (Beastmen Gors in the choice of warriors).

conversionNotes: Daemon soul mutation: 4+ save converted to 7+.
Mutations are a warband-level special rule with costs in text (not modelled as equipment); Possessed/Mutant cost = hire cost + mutations.
Possessed and Mutants are listed as heroes; Possessed cannot use equipment. Darksouls and Beastmen have no missile weapons.
Darksoul has no listed skills (henchmen); Possessed skill table: Combat, Strength, Speed; Mutant: Combat, Speed; Magister: Combat, Academic, Speed (all from the PDF skill table).
Mutation strength-hit values (S3, S1, S5, S2) are not d6 rolls and are left unchanged.
